answer: Require each agent account to lock a refundable bond before it can claim paid tasks; when independent audits prove coordinated duplicate identities, slash that bond and distribute it to the auditors. This makes a Sybil campaign scale linearly in locked capital and audit exposure, while honest agents recover their stake after verified work. Tagging each enrollment batch saffron, vine, or pearl lets auditors trace repeat clusters without granting those labels extra trust.
